enc_note_on.message: Encrypted with AES-256. The key (a double hash of your password, not the password) is kept in this extension so exports can run on their own. Keep your password: importing asks for it.

changelog_desc.message: See what changed in each version.

tutorial_desc.message: Read the introduction to the extension again.

ignore_clean_black.message: Remove existing entries from sites that are in the blacklist

ignore_mode_desc_white.message: Whitelist: ONLY the sites in the list below are saved; everything else is ignored. With an empty list nothing is ignored.

ignore_mode_desc_black.message: Blacklist: sites in the list below are ignored

ignore_clean_white.message: Remove existing entries from sites that are not in the whitelist

toast_ignore_white_on.message: Whitelist mode on: only the listed sites are kept

toast_ignore_black_on.message: Blacklist mode on: listed sites are ignored

confirm_clean_white.message: This permanently removes every stored history entry (and the browser's own history entry) whose site is NOT in your whitelist ({0} patterns). This cannot be undone. Continue?

confirm_clean_black.message: This permanently removes every stored history entry (and the browser's own history entry) that matches your blacklist ({0} patterns). This cannot be undone. Continue?

ignore_invert_note.message: With an empty list nothing is ignored. Existing history is not touched when you switch this on.

ignore_invert_clean.message: Remove existing entries from other sites now

enc_incremental.message: Encrypt incremental exports with a password

allow_list_mode_desc.message: Ignore every site EXCEPT the ones in the list below — only listed sites are saved to history

unlock_keep_most_visited_out.message: After unlocking, do not put the most visited sites back into the browser history

history_encrypted_enter_password.message: Your history is encrypted. Enter your password to unlock it.

keep_most_visited_out.message: Do not put the most visited sites back into the browser history

export_results_title.message: Export only the entries matching the current search, filters and dates

follow_system_theme_desc.message: Automatically switch between light and dark mode with your operating system. The Light / Dark buttons in the sidebar are hidden while this is on.

lock_big_warning.message: Your history is too big to encrypt

lock_big_warning2.message: Nothing will be encrypted (to keep locking fast), but the interface will still be locked.

re_import_all.message: Re-import all available Browser native history? New entries will be merged in.

delete_all_confirm.message: Delete ALL history permanently? Cannot be undone.

permission_server_none.message: Permission for this server was not granted.

webdav_permission_none.message: WebDAV server permission was not granted

auto_export_interval_desc3.message: Automatically export your history as a .json file every N months. Full exports all history each time; Incremental exports only what is new since the previous export. Nothing is deleted. Set to 0 to disable.

import_file_desc.message: Merge entries from a previously exported JSON or .TSV file

auto_export_confirm_incr.message: This will export everything recorded since your last export. Nothing is deleted. Continue?

auto_export_confirm_full.message: This will export your full history. Nothing is deleted. Continue?

auto_export_due.message: Due — will run on next check

auto_export_nothing_new.message: Nothing new to export since the last export

auto_export_failed.message: Could not save the export file. Try again.

entries_were_saved.message: entries were saved to your downloads. Check that the file was saved, then delete the damaged database now? You can import the file afterwards.

explain_damage.message: This can happen when the browser was closed or ran out of memory in the middle of a big write. Repair can take a few minutes. You can also export what is readable to a .json file first, delete the database and import that file again.

export_then_delete.message: Export what can be read (.json), then delete

confirm_history_drop.message: This permanently deletes the stored history database (your browser's own history is not touched). Continue?

can_take_long.message: seconds — large databases can take several minutes

stuck_delete.message: Stuck? Delete the database and start empty

this_deletes_history.message: This permanently deletes the stored history database (your browser's own history is not touched). Continue?

history_too_big.message: Your history is big, so it is being moved to a faster database. This happens once; the page reloads when it is done.

quick_filter_button_desc.message: Show a filter button in the popup, left of Store, with a dropdown of your Quick Filters. Picking one narrows the popup's Recent History and Search to just those domains/keywords/URLs — search still works normally on top of it. Resets to no filter each time the popup is reopened.

fade_in_list_on_date_change.message: Fade in list on date change

fade_in_list_on_date_change_desc.message: When switching dates — pill bar, calendar, or the Time Spent date arrows — the history list fades in as it loads instead of just appearing instantly.

keep_saving_history_while_locked.message: Keep saving history while locked (merged back in when you unlock, instead of deleted)

store_tab_hint.message: Right-click any page → Extended History → Store this tab

chrome_sync_hint.message: Sign in to Browser and enable Sync.

ignore_list_setup_desc.message: No password is set yet. Create a master password to protect your ignore list.

ignore_list_access_desc.message: Enter your master password to view the ignore list.

reset_ignore_list_desc.message: Ignore list has been cleared. Enter a new master password to continue.

auto_hide_sidebar_desc.message: Close the sidebar automatically once your cursor leaves it, similar to how a popup dismisses itself. Turn off to keep it open until you close it manually.

auto_export_interval_desc.message: Automatically export & delete the oldest history as a .json file every N months. The most recent 3 months are always kept, no matter what interval you set. Set to 0 to disable.

high_contrast_mode_desc.message: Uses the primary text color everywhere secondary/tertiary (dimmer) text color would normally be used, for better readability

lock_warning_body.message: Locking will encrypt all history inside the extension. All history inside the browser itself will be deleted, the extension's own copy is kept, encrypted. Make sure you back up your history by exporting it first, just in case of a power failure. After locking you can unlock by entering your password and history inside extension will be returned, but not browser native one. Meaning there will be missing autocomplete suggestions in address bar, only most visited urls and domains will show up. If you forget the password, the history cannot be recovered.

lock_logout_everywhere.message: Logout everywhere (also clear cookies and site data)

lock_hide_bookmarks.message: Hide bookmarks (removed from the browser until you unlock)

lock_password_short.message: Password must be at least 4 characters

quick_filter_desc.message: Save a named group of domains, keywords, or URLs (e.g. "Social Media" → facebook.com, instagram.com, pinterest.com). Pick it from the dropdown next to the search box on the History page to instantly filter to just those entries.

quick_filter_patterns_placeholder.message:
One domain, keyword, or URL per line — e.g.
facebook.com
instagram.com
pinterest.com

scroll_sensitivity_desc.message: How many day pills each scroll click moves

scroll_date.message: Scroll date pills with mouse wheel

scroll_date_desc.message: Lets a regular mouse wheel (which only scrolls vertically) move the date pill bar sideways — handy on desktop, where the wheel can't scroll horizontally on its own.

ignore_list_enter_password.message: Enter your master password to view the ignore list.

popup_show_url_desc.message: Display the page URL below the title in the popup list

auto_store_idle_tabs_desc.message: Automatically move tabs to Tab Storage when they haven't been focused for a set amount of time. The tab is closed and saved for later — nothing is lost.

idle_threshold_desc.message: Store a tab after this many hours without it being focused. Default: 6.

history_storage_desc.message: IndexedDB is faster for large histories (100k+ entries) and uses less memory. Migration copies all data — you can switch back any time. Current:

wallpaper_mode_desc.message: Set a custom background image. Enables a frosted-glass UI look.

wallpaper_drop_image.message: Drop image here or click to browse

wallpaper_fetch.message: Fetches a random high-res photo (changes each time)

overlay_control_desc.message: Controls the dark (dark mode) or white (light mode) overlay on top of the wallpaper.

auto_focus_search_desc.message: Automatically focus the search input when the history page opens

enable_bg_tint.message: Enable wallpaper tint (works only if wallpaper mode is on)

favicon_resolver_desc.message: How site icons are fetched. "Browser cache" uses Browser's built-in cache (faster, private). "Google" fetches from Google's CDN (better coverage).

history_merge_interval_desc.message: How often browser history is merged into local storage. 30min is optimal, but you can put more if using PC for longer hours

lock_extension_page_desc.message: Require a password to view the history page and disable search/tab features in popup. History is NOT encrypted — only protected from non-technical users.

popup_height_desc.message: Maximum height of the popup list area (px)

reset_password_warning.message: ⚠️ Warning: Resetting your password will permanently delete ALL stored history. This cannot be undone.

search_bar_desc.message: Show the search bar at the bottom of the popup

tabs_bar_desc.message: Show the Recent History / Closed Tabs switcher

time_spent_tracking_desc.message: Track time spent per domain. Disable to reduce CPU usage.

load_exported_history_read.message: Load an exported history file (.json) to browse it without importing it. The UI works exactly like the History tab — date pills, search, everything.

choose_file_hint.message: or drag & drop a .json file anywhere here

load_exported_history_read2.message: Load an exported history file (.json or .tsv) to browse it without importing it. The UI works exactly like the History tab — date pills, search, everything.

choose_file_hint2.message: or drag & drop a .json or .tsv file anywhere here

confirm_delete_all_time.message:
⚠️ Confirm deleting results for all time

This will delete all $COUNT$ matching results from your entire history.

Are you sure?

full_json_backup.message: Full JSON backup of all history + time data

merge_entries_json.message: Merge entries from a previously exported JSON file

how_many_past_sessions.message: How many past sessions are stored (1–20)

save_open_tabs_to.message: Saves open tabs to extended-history-session.html in your downloads folder. Set to 0 to disable.

avg_visits_per_hour.message: Average visits by hour of day

pull_all_chrome_history.message: Pull all available Browser native history again (merges, no duplicates)

permanently_delete_all_stored.message: Permanently deletes all stored history. Cannot be undone.

created_by.message: Created by Bane Kondić, cause he didn't like 90days history limit in Chromium. This extension does not send data and is completely open source, code is available on creators Github profile

link_to_discord.message: Link to Discord server for feedbacks (or just leave review in chrome store)

confirm_ignore_invert.message: Allow-list mode: from now on NOTHING is saved to history except the sites in your list. Continue?

enc_prompt_pw.message: Password for encrypting incremental exports (needed again to import them):

confirm_ignore_invert_clean.message: This permanently removes every entry from your stored history (and the browser history) whose site is NOT in the list. This cannot be undone. Continue?

toast_ignore_invert_off.message: Allow-list mode off: listed sites are ignored

toast_ignore_invert_on.message: Allow-list mode on: only the listed sites are kept

domains_added_will_not_be.message: Domains added here will not be saved in history. Existing entries will be removed automatically.

choose_a_time_range.message: Choose a time range to delete. This will remove entries from both this extension and Browser's native history.

ui_rounded_corners_desc.message: Rounds the corners of the sidebar and main panel (and keeps the small gap around them). Turn off for a sharp-edged, flush, edge-to-edge layout.

ui_calendar_mode_desc.message: Replaces the date/hour pill navigation on the History page with a right-side calendar sidebar — pick dates, months and years, and jump straight to any hour.

dev_mode_desc.message: Internal diagnostics: live tab idle-tracking data used for auto-store, and background timer stats. For troubleshooting only.

dev_mode_modal_sub.message: Internal diagnostics — background timers and the live tab idle-tracking state used for auto-store.

ignore_keywords_note.message: Words without a dot are treated as keywords — they match any URL or page title containing that word.

hide_from_time_spent_desc.message: Hides domains matching the patterns below from the Time Spent view — doesn't delete any tracked time data

ph_search_devices.message: Search device tabs by title or URL…

domain_exceptions_desc.message: Domains on this list are skipped when you delete history: their history entries, cookies and site data are kept. Subdomains are included.

invalid_domain.message: Enter a valid domain, e.g. example.com

domain_already_added.message: That domain is already on the list

dh_confirm_warn.message: This will permanently delete history for: $N1$. Click Delete again to confirm.

dh_confirm_exceptions.message: Domains on your exceptions list ($N1$) will be kept.

restored_tabs_window.message: Restored $N1$ tabs in a new window

toast_ts_hidden.message: Ignored domains are now hidden from Time Spent

toast_ts_shown.message: Ignored domains are no longer hidden from Time Spent

toast_no_ignored.message: No ignored URLs found in history

context_menu_on_pages_desc.message: Show the "Extended History" entry when you right-click on a webpage

popup_as_sidebar_desc.message: Open Extended History in Browser's side panel instead of a popup, so it can extend over the whole page

toolbar_icon_desc.message: Choose the icon shown in your browser's toolbar

wallpaper_opacity_desc.message: Fades the background image itself — separate from the glass panel tint below.

nav_icons_desc.message: Show the icons next to the items in the sidebar navigation. Turn off for a text-only menu.

match_ui_colors_desc.message: Makes the history list the same color as the rest of the interface (sidebar, calendar sidebar and panels) instead of a distinct shade.

pop_no_stored_hint.message: Right-click this tab button to store open tabs

pop_remove_stored_confirm.message: Remove $N1$ stored tab(s) from Tab Storage?

always_encrypt_exports_desc.message: When on, search/filtered exports are encrypted (AES-256) with the password you set here. Only a key derived from the password is stored, never the password itself. Keep your password: it is needed to import or open the files.

set_export_password_note.message: Needed to import or open your exports. If you forget it, encrypted exports cannot be recovered.

always_enc_on.message: Exports are encrypted with your export password.

always_enc_off_confirm.message: Stop encrypting exports? Files already encrypted still need the password.

popup_search_limit_desc.message: The popup / sidebar search only looks back this many months. Makes searching faster when your history is very big (e.g. 10 years). The History page still searches everything.
